crossRefs.note: But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, why do you turn back again to the weak and…
You observe days, months, seasons, and years.
Let no one therefore judge you in eating, or in drinking, or with respect to a feast day or a new moon or a Sabbath day,
which are a shadow of the things to come; but the body is Christ’s.
I know, and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus, that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers…
But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.
However, that knowledge isn’t in all men. But some, with consciousness of the idol until now, eat as of a thing…
And through your knowledge, he who is weak perishes, the brother for whose sake Christ died.
And by this we know that we are of the truth, and persuade our hearts before him,

translations.web: One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.
translations.bsb: One person regards a certain day above the others, while someone else considers every day alike. Each one should be fully convinced in his own mind.
translations.kjv: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day alike. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.
translations.asv: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.
